pressure_points.text: The framed story is too narrow for the motivating exact-Lagrangian case because the Lagrangian difference map can obstruct framing.
Orientation data, spectral local systems, and filtration data appear separately in earlier examples, creating pressure for one common formalism rather than three parallel ones.
Tangential data must be adjustable rather than fixed, which is why the tangential-pair technology matters in the supporting genealogy.

missing_cell_analysis.text: Lar21, Dou05, and Fur02 were not directly read as primary texts in this bounded run, so their inclusion is supported by target-side discussion rather than by direct downstream quotation.
No depth-2 ancestor survived adjudication because the run did not read enough downstream source text to support a stronger backward chain beyond the target's own framing.
The Furuta-origin thread stays downgraded because the target itself marks it as tentative and the underlying preprint remained unread.

transferred.text: From AB24: framed flow categories as stable-categorical machinery and construction style.
From Lar21: the exact-Lagrangian flow-category input and its non-framed pressure.
From Dou05 and the surrounding agenda: twisted stable homotopy as the right target-side language for the non-framed setting.
From PS24: tangential-structure tuning as a mechanism for changing the structure carried by the same Floer data.

novel.text: The target's distinctive move is the mu-structured synthesis that identifies structured flow categories with twisted presheaves.

blind_reconstruction.text: Start from the exact-Lagrangian Floer case where framing fails, preserve the geometric input as a flow category anyway, package orientation, local-system, and filtration behavior through a single mu:C->U/O formalism, and demand that the resulting stable category agree with the twisted-presheaf category suggested by those inputs.

agreements.text: The reconstruction agrees closely with the target's own framing: non-framed Floer input, twisted-presheaf output, and the role of mu-structured flow categories in between.

undershoots.text: This genealogy run undershoots the paper's deeper internal machinery, especially the later enriched-categorical and bordism-technical layers, because it bounded itself to the target's readable framing plus one reinforcement check.

reconstructed_question.text: Can one keep the exact-Lagrangian and other non-framed Floer flow-category inputs, allow orientation/local-system/filtration data to interact through a single mu-structure, and still recover the correct stable target category as twisted presheaves?

confidence_and_uncertainty.text: Confidence is medium. Target access is strong because the paper body and source archive were directly read, and the main depth-1 seeds are explicitly named by the target. Confidence is capped because the run did not directly read most downstream seed texts, so the genealogy is strongest on the paper's immediate conceptual parents and weakest on deeper historical claims.
